reports.description: Complete updated database structure documentation with tables, relationships, constraints, and migration-aware schema reconciliation

87 migrations successfully applied

reports.title: Database Security & Performance Audit
reports.description: Comprehensive database audit covering security policies, performance issues, schema mismatches, and data anomalies
key_findings: RLS disabled on 17 critical tables
23 foreign keys missing performance indexes
Multiple permissive RLS policies creating conflicts
Postgres version has outstanding security patches

reports.title: Security & Compliance Analysis
reports.description: Security-focused analysis covering authentication vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, CORS misconfiguration, and compliance gaps
key_findings: Hardcoded API keys and secrets in source code
Firebase-Supabase authentication integration vulnerabilities
No rate limiting or DDoS protection implemented
Missing security headers and CORS configuration

reports.title: Project Functionality & Features Inventory
reports.description: Complete mapping of application features, API endpoints, background jobs, and database object relationships
key_findings: Multi-tenant architecture with 3 user roles
15 core feature domains identified
Complex booking and payment workflows
Missing API documentation and error handling

reports.title: Performance & Scalability Analysis
reports.description: Performance bottlenecks analysis including database optimization, caching opportunities, and scalability concerns
key_findings: 23 unindexed foreign keys causing slow joins
RLS policies re-evaluating for each row
35+ unused indexes consuming storage
No caching layer implemented

reports.title: Test Coverage & Quality Analysis
reports.description: Analysis of testing infrastructure, coverage gaps, and quality assurance processes
key_findings: No automated testing infrastructure
Zero test coverage for critical business logic
No integration tests for database operations
Manual testing only for mobile applications

reports.title: CI/CD & Infrastructure Analysis
reports.description: Analysis of deployment pipelines, infrastructure setup, environment management, and DevOps practices
key_findings: No automated CI/CD pipeline implemented
Manual deployment process with no quality gates
Hardcoded secrets in build configuration
No monitoring or alerting infrastructure

Remove hardcoded secrets from source code
